subject: Evidence handoff and ephemeral download plan for SOC 2 artifacts
messages:
From: Lina Patel <lina.patel@kestrel-audit.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: security-team@acme-payments.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: download window & export format for SOC 2 artifacts

Mateo,

We're kicking off our fieldwork for Acme Payments' 2028 SOC 2 Type II review. To complete the controls testing for change management and logging, we need a short-term access window to download the evidence bundle from your Trust Portal. A few specifics from our side: 

- Preferred method: one-time SSO or ephemeral secure link (no long-lived service account).
- Export format: single encrypted ZIP containing CSV manifest + original PDFs/exports.
- We require MD5 or SHA256 checksums for each archive.
- Export window: ideally a contiguous 48-hour window in the week of Mar 25–31.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the ephemeral link and support PGP-encrypted payloads (we can send a key) and whether you will provide a bridge letter confirming the audit window? Also include any timelines for deprovisioning reviewer accounts after downloads.

Thanks,
Lina Patel
Senior Auditor, Kestrel Audit LLP
lina.patel@kestrel-audit.com

--
Lina Patel
Kestrel Audit LLP
Phone: +1 415 555 0192
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Lina Patel <lina.patel@kestrel-audit.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: download window & export format for SOC 2 artifacts

Thanks Lina — we can support this.

Quick plan proposal:
- Scope: we'll include the control evidence identified in the attached CSV (requested-evidence-list.csv) — if you need additional items call them out in reply.
- Delivery: we will produce a single ZIP export, PGP-encrypted by auditor key (please send public key).
- Checksums: we will provide SHA256 checksums for the archive and a manifest mapping files to checksums.
- Access method: ephemeral SSO link tied to your reviewer identity (no persistent account). The link will be timeboxed and IP-restricted to the addresses you provide if necessary.
- Deprovisioning: default is automatic expiry of the link + automatic session revoke; we'll deprovision any temporary reviewer mapping within 24 hours after the last successful download.

Marissa (cc) owns the Trust Portal invites — Marissa, can you confirm the earliest window you can spin up the export and whether we can meet the 48-hour contiguous window Lina requested? Neha (cc) will track the bridge letter wording.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Lina Patel <lina.patel@kestrel-audit.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: security-team@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: download window & export format for SOC 2 artifacts

Thanks Mateo — confirming scope in-line: change management, logging/monitoring exports, provisioning evidence (screenshots + audit logs), and the SOC 2 report artifacts for the period Oct 1, 2027–Mar 31, 2028.

PGP key: https://keys.kestrel-audit.com/lina-2028.pub
IP restrictions: we can allow these ranges during the download window: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/28

We can accept a 48-hour contiguous window beginning any time on Mar 25–31; preference is Mar 25 08:00 UTC. If you must start later in the week, let us know.

Also: we will need a short bridge letter confirming the audit period and that Redwood will provide short-term evidence access. If you can attach a draft we'll review and sign.

Regards,
Lina

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Lina Patel <lina.patel@kestrel-audit.com>
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: download window & export format for SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Lina — looping in with operational details.

What we will provide:
- One-time ephemeral SSO session link (not a persistent Okta account) tied to your reviewer email.
- Download window: 48 hours. Proposed window: Mar 25 08:00 UTC — Mar 27 08:00 UTC. If you prefer a start on Mar 26, we can accommodate; tell us which you prefer.
- Export: single ZIP (evidence_bundle_v1.zip) containing a CSV manifest, original files, and a short README with collection methods.
- Encryption: we will PGP-encrypt the ZIP with the key you provided.
- Checksums: SHA256 for the archive and per-file entries in evidence_export_manifest.csv.
- Deprovision: temporary reviewer mapping will be revoked within 24 hours after the final download; the ephemeral link will expire at the end of the 48-hour window.

Attached: bridge-letter-draft.pdf (please review and suggest edits). We will also attach a placeholder evidence bundle to validate access during the session start — file name: evidence_bundle_v1.zip (placeholder).

Can you confirm acceptance of the proposed Mar 25 08:00 UTC window? Also confirm whether you want the export to be staged behind the IP ranges you supplied.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Portal Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment(s): bridge-letter-draft.pdf; evidence_bundle_v1.zip (placeholder)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Lina Patel <lina.patel@kestrel-audit.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: download window & export format for SOC 2 artifacts

Lina — thanks for the quick review and confirmations. Final notes before we flip the switch: 

- Window confirmed: Mar 25 08:00 UTC — Mar 27 08:00 UTC (we will stage the ZIP at 07:45 UTC to allow a short validation check).
- IP allowlist: we will apply the two ranges you provided for the session.
- Manifest: final evidence_export_manifest.csv will be attached to the export and we will publish SHA256 for the whole archive and per-file entries.
- Bridge letter: Neha will send the final signed copy once you confirm the edits to bridge-letter-draft.pdf.
- Post-download: we will revoke the reviewer mapping within 24 hours; if you require immediate deprovisioning after a download event, note that in reply.
- DocuSign: please sign the acknowledgement for the export at this link once the bridge letter is ok: https://docusign.com/secure/embedding/ABC-EX-789

We will rotate the temporary artifact storage keys after the export for additional hygiene. If all set, we'll provide the ephemeral session URL 24 hours before the start time.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachment(s): evidence_export_manifest.csv
